output.reason: The migration guide [ev-dbef3e2e8163] says only that these Headers middleware options "have been removed". It does not say whether configurations that still use them are rejected, ignored or cause errors. The proposed resource-rejected claim says the field "is no longer served", but the CRD validator refuted this: spec.headers.sslRedirect is still in the v3.0.0 traefik.io Middleware schema [ev-0842f8f3bd9d], so the evidence gives no basis for the API server rejecting such resources. The item also groups five options into one, and the evidence does not show what actually happens to them, so no corrected consequence follows.
